RESOLUTION.DESC:
The Security Council,
Acknowledging that Xoriet was commended by Security Council Resolution #266, largely on the basis of their long service to [region]The East Pacific[/region] and [region]Lone Wolves United[/region],
Reiterating existing Security Council precedent that a nation's inactivity or dissolution does not preclude it from continuing commendability, but that affirmative conduct undermining the text of a commendation or a figure's legacy may necessitate repeal,
Believing there to be several content deficiencies in Commend Xoriet in regards to commendability and detail, and further misdeeds undertaken on the part of this nation have undermined the original text of the commendation,
Addressing items related to The East Pacific, which form a core element of the target commendation such as:
[list][*]Disclosing information from The East Pacific’s private venues, using historically-entrusted access, to inflame tensions with the West Pacific whilst the Pacific was allied to both, leading to the end of East-West relations until 2025, allowing the Pacific to attempt to manipulate both, [*]Interfering in The East Pacific’s judicial system in 2025, with the aim of protecting the political stature and Delegate candidacy of an entryist based in Lone Wolves United, [*]Scheming amongst the Pacifican Senate to the previous end, and more broadly on how to undermine multiple-term Delegate and longtime native A Mean Old Man within The East Pacific,[/list]
Repudiating with firm disgust the [i]Remarking[/i] clause, which notes that through the satellite nation of [nation]Anerastreia[/nation], they contributed to an organization which has routinely antagonized, tormented, and interfered with both native communities and their own allies alike, actions not seen as commendable and out of accord with a commendation otherwise purporting to celebrate positive contributions to the world and a Feeder in particular,
Recalling that Xoriet arrived in the Pacific (New Pacific Order) in 2018 and rose through the ranks of the Senate in the aftermath of [nation]Pergamon[/nation], [nation]A Mean Old Man[/nation], and [nation]Feux[/nation]’s expulsion from the region, becoming one of the faces of the region’s rehabilitation efforts. In their service to the Pacific, they undertook a variety of pursuits that undermine their overall commendability including:
[list][*]Advancing the Pax Polaris Occidens, marketed as a watershed project amongst [region]the Pacific[/region], [region]The North Pacific[/region], and [region]the West Pacific[/region] to deter against invader aggression. Xoriet and the Pacific never intended to enforce its provisions, leaving the North and West’s allies to languish as invasion targets, materially unaided by the agreement at-large, [*]Agitating for the temporary dismissal of [nation]Varanius[/nation] as Minister of Foreign Affairs of the West Pacific by exercising undue influence over its then-Delegate, solely as a result of Varanius’ requests that the Pacific honor their treaty obligations under the Pax Polaris Occidens, [*]Upon return to public activity and taking the throne, immediately signing a formal alliance with Lone Wolves United, prolonging their global relevance and bolstering their ability to conduct destructive invasions, many of which the Legio Pacifica participated in, [*]Importing [nation]Pasybfic[/nation] ([nation]Syberis[/nation]), a former Pharaoh of [region]Osiris[/region], into the region and its diplomatic corps. Pasybfic would go on to serve as Senator, Regent, and Emperor and order the Legio Pacifica to perform several destructive invasions alongside Lone Wolves United, which Xoriet then produced propaganda in defense thereof, [*]Hosting secret peace talks with [region]the Brotherhood of Malice[/region], aiming to secure an effective surrender by The North Pacific and bring the invader organization into political normalcy, explicitly without protection for and at the expense of various Independent and defender regions, including regions the Pacific had alliances or non-aggression pacts with,[/list]
Surmising that absent the since-undermined or repudiated content covering The East Pacific and Lone Wolves United, the target commendation remains rather sparse, and that this combined with the nation’s treacheries and antagonism in years since warrants a repeal of this commendation,
Eternally grateful that many of these schemes were eventually undone, prevented, or mitigated,
Hereby repeals Security Council Resolution #266, “Commend Xoriet.”
RESOLUTION.NAME: Repeal "Commend Xoriet"
